Usually: open Phone Master (or Settings > Battery) > App launch or Power saving, find NexGuard, and allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Then lock NexGuard in the recent-apps screen.
Usually: Settings > Apps > NexGuard > Battery > Unrestricted. Also make sure NexGuard is not in Sleeping apps.
Usually: Settings > Apps > NexGuard > turn on Autostart, then Battery saver > No restrictions.
Usually: Settings > Battery > App launch > NexGuard > Manage manually, and turn on all three switches.
Usually: Settings > Battery > NexGuard > Allow background activity, and turn on Auto-launch.

After setup, this phone\'s location is shared with your NexGuard account. A notification always shows while it is shared.
A few permissions let NexGuard keep working when the app is closed or the screen is locked.
NexGuard shows a notification while it protects this phone, and shows alarms and messages from you.
NexGuard collects this phone\'s location and sends it to your NexGuard account, so you can find the phone if it is lost. Choose \"Precise\".
To keep finding the phone when NexGuard is closed or the screen is locked, choose \"Allow all the time\" on the next screen. Your location is only shared with your own account.
Without \"Allow all the time\", NexGuard only works while the app is open or its notification is showing.
Many phones stop apps in the background to save battery. Let NexGuard run without restrictions. %1$s
Choose a PIN that only you know. It is needed to stop protection on this phone.
